svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; ITU-T SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Class C accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate the timing features
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 1PPS in/out on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMA, ToD in on RJ45, BITS in on RJ48 (datasheet Timing Interfaces)
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS, 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD; shielded RJ48 for BITS (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable Types)
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 and micro-USB, one interface on two connectors (labelled IOIO)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

rect.data-members: gnss-ant clk-1pps-in clk-1pps-out clk-10mhz-in clk-10mhz-out bits tod

g.data-description: HIG section 10 Front Panel LED table, GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning, self-survey not complete), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground)
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG section 10 Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG section 10 Front Panel LED table, STAT row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG section 10 Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (all fan modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fan modules fail or no fan module present)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG section 10 Front Panel LED table, PWR row - Off (no power or shutdown), Solid Green (system power good), Blinking Green (system power good but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but CPU power fail), Blinking Yellow (system power fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-mgmt-left: HIG section 10 Management port LED table, Left LED - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt-right: HIG section 10 Management port LED table, Right LED - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so they are declared separately
